messages:
Alex: quick ping — PR #58321 updates routing fallback for model-cache lease. Needs runtime + infra + security eyes before canary. TL;DR: changes eviction header ordering + forwards authz header on internal grpc route. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/58321

Alex: planning to merge in tomorrow's 10:00 UTC merge window if no blockers. Who can own merge steward and canary? Prefer runtime for rollback + infra for network/TTL checks + security for authz review.

Sam: taking runtime review, will look in the next hour. Any perf regressions expected?

Alex: thanks @Sam. Perf shouldn't change — it's a header reorder + forwarding. Staging perf looked flat. Quick diff excerpt:
```diff
-  req.headers['x-eviction-order'] = 'legacy'
+  req.headers['x-eviction-order'] = 'lease-first'
+  req.headers['x-internal-authz'] = token
```

Riley: I can take infra/network checks, can do a pass tomorrow morning (10–30m). cc @Lee for canary schedule.

Morgan: Security can do a quick authz review today. Is this adding any new scopes/permissions?

Alex: @Morgan no new scopes — we only forward the existing internal token in a new header `x-internal-authz`. Test plan and logs scrub added to the PR. Also added a rollback hook that disables header forwarding.

Jordan: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-07-18T10:00:00Z (merge window slot). Assigned: @Sam runtime steward, @Riley infra steward, @Lee canary owner.

Sam: quick note — spotted a flaky in allocator_test when running locally; will push a tiny fix in a follow-up commit. Not a functional blocker but will land before canary if possible.

Alex: 👍 I'll wait for the fix. If it's not in by 09:30 UTC we can still merge and hotfix afterwards, but prefer everything green.

Riley: infra nit — header name uses snake_case in one place (x_lease_ttl_ms). Platform prefers kebab-case. Can we normalize to `x-lease-ttl-ms`? Leaving inline comment.

Alex: updated to kebab-case in the branch, pushed. PTAL @Riley @Morgan.

Morgan: LGTM from security, left one non-blocking comment about ensuring we don't accidentally log raw tokens (please mask).

Sam: runtime LGTM — ran perf bench and local integration tests, all good. I'll steward merge and smoke canary.

Lee: I can own canary. Plan: 5% traffic for 30m, then 20% for 1h if stable. If errors >1% or latency +200ms, I'll roll back. I'll post status in #incidents if we see anything.

Alex: thanks everyone. Merge window tomorrow 10:00 UTC; @Sam will merge. If you have a veto, please speak up before 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup: 

Sam: merging at 10:00 UTC barring other blockers. cc @Morgan @Riley @Lee

deploy-bot: Merge queued for PR #58321 — will attempt merge at window start.

Alex: noted — will follow up after canary baseline. Thanks all!
